title: Tiny, cute train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground track -->
  <rect x='5' y='76' width='90' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <rect x='8' y='80' width='84' height='4' rx='1' fill='#8aa0c4'/>
  <!-- sleepers -->
  <rect x='15' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='45' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <rect x='75' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='1' fill='#7a5a3a'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='6' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='3' fill='#c8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='72' r='6' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='72' r='3' fill='#c8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='6' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='3' fill='#c8d8f0'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='72' r='6' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='72' r='3' fill='#c8d8f0'/>

  <!-- engine body -->
  <rect x='12' y='44' width='42' height='26' rx='4' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- engine top highlight -->
  <rect x='12' y='44' width='42' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff6b60'/>
  <!-- cabin -->
  <rect x='50' y='36' width='26' height='34' rx='4' fill='#3a6ae8'/>
  <rect x='50' y='36' width='26' height='9' rx='4' fill='#5a8aff'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='56' y='42' width='14' height='12' rx='2' fill='#a8d8ff'/>
  <rect x='56' y='42' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d0ecff'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='18' y='32' width='10' height='14' rx='2' fill='#c03530'/>
  <rect x='15' y='28' width='16' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='23' cy='22' r='5' fill='#d8e8f8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='16' r='4' fill='#e8f2ff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='12' r='3' fill='#f0f6ff'/>
  <!-- front bumper -->
  <rect x='8' y='60' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#f0c040'/>
  <!-- coupling -->
  <rect x='76' y='58' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8a030'/>
  <!-- headlamp -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffe860'/>
  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x='12' y='58' width='42' height='4' fill='#f0c040'/>
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='48' y='32' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2a4ab8'/>

  <!-- cargo car -->
  <rect x='82' y='56' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#3aaa5a'/>
  <rect x='82' y='56' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5acc7a'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='4' fill='#e8a040'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='2' fill='#f8c870'/>
</svg>
